assumptions: 'truth' on a v5 checkpoint is the fixture's documented 'expected' plus the AST 'answer_spec'; preflight accepts either key and requires the derivation, because the real LR-01.v5.json carries 'expected', not 'truth'.

The runner reports no request quota, so the 4,320 remainder is computed best-effort as the cap minus rows already on disk in experiments/ptr-engine/measure/ and is labelled best-effort wherever printed.
would_send_total is the runner's dry-run count for the fixture's full N; when --turns truncates a cell the dry-run figure is conservative (higher than the run), never lower.
Each row in a rows file is one request; requests_used counts rows written by the runner (zero in --offline mode).
